div.div:
DEFENSES
· SameSite=Lax/Strict — cookie not sent on cross-site POSTs
· synchronizer CSRF token — proves request came from your page
· Origin / Sec-Fetch-Site check — server-side origin validation

Key insight: CSRF works because cookies are attached by ambient browser behavior —
the request never needed the attacker's code to run in your origin.
